newsitem.title: UK: TI Group declines comment on bid talk.
newsitem.headline: TI Group declines comment on bid talk.

text.p: Engineering and aerospace company TI Group on Wednesday declined to comment on press reports that it may launch a bid for Senior Engineering.
A spokesman for the company said it was policy not to comment on market rumours.
But one industry source poured cold water on the speculation, saying: "There's nothing whatsoever in this rumour either in part or in whole."
The bid talk was highlighted in the Financial Times newspaper, which said TI might launch a bid for Senior or was interested in acquiring its auto and industrial tubing subsidiary, Flexonics.
Shares in Senior were 4-1/2p higher at 114p after rising 4p yesterday.
TI group was up 4-1/2p at 575p after dipping to 563p in early trading.
